question: A train starts moving from a place A at 10:00 a.m. and arrives at another place B at 5:30 p.m. on the same day. If the speed of the train is 80 km/hr, then what will be the distance covered by the train?
solution:
Given:

A train starts moving from place A at 10:00 a.m. and arrives at place B at 5:30 p.m. on the same day.

The speed of the train is 80 km/hr

Concept used:

Distance = speed × time

Calculation:

Total time is taken 10:00 am to 5:30 p.m. = 7.5 hr

So, the distance will be,

⇒ 7.5 × 80 = 600 km
